answer: Every submission is re-executed at random by three peers who share no operator, and the pulse of each replay is compared before payment releases. Copies die on the ledger, since a replayed answer matches an earlier entry no matter which name signed it. Take one task, a delivery routed over a two-day voyage: three nodes re-run it and the odd vertex shows in the first minute. Whether a patient cartel can field three agreeing shills remains the open gap.
